controller_observation.original_manager_outcome: Completed a truthful blocked response while retaining an incomplete task and pending native file-change request.
controller_observation.mistake: The controller unconditionally called managedRun after coordinator completion. Because the workflow phase was execution, this launched a new resumption instead of only finishing an awaiting-native-completion closure. Endpoint shutdown then interrupted that extra attempt.
controller_observation.attribution: Controller/operator lifecycle mistake, separate from the already observed native Windows editing failure. The interruption is retained in signed receipts and is not attributed to an agent or account-access failure.

source_provenance.observation: Cornell MCP schema, practice scaffold handling and draft-revision support changed during this run. These changes did not alter the recipe or protected oracle. NativeSession configures a separate CLI MCP subprocess per thread, so newly started native threads load the current disk surface while already running MCP processes retain their earlier module loads. The persistent controller may retain directly imported core modules. Per-thread MCP module bytes were not separately captured at spawn; the report does not infer an exact surface version from hardcoded labels.
